name: Key Lime Pie
subtitle: A Jill & Rick specialty
time: ~4 hr 30 min, ~20 min hands-on (mostly chilling; estimated)

steps.title: Blend the filling
steps.body: Blend together: **8 oz cream cheese**, **1 can sweetened condensed milk**, **1 egg** and **⅓ cup key lime juice**.

steps.title: Fill and chill
steps.body: Pour into a prepared or homemade graham cracker pie crust (**1½ cups graham cracker crumbs**, **2 Tbsp sugar**, **1 Tbsp brown sugar**, **7 Tbsp melted butter**), and chill.
